SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.CLTCB.US.A' AND period IN ('2005', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Which specialties have the most clinicians opting out of Medicare?
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the price power plants paid for natural gas change from January to December 2020?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT month, avg(try_cast(fuel_cost AS double)) AS avg_cost FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Natural Gas' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND try_cast(month AS integer) IN (1, 12) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY try_cast(month AS integer) LIMIT 10
Which utilities cancelled the most nuclear reactors?
SELECT utility, count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_canceled_query_5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. crude oil exports change from January 2015 to January 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_barrels_per_day FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.MCREXUS2.M' AND period IN ('201501', '202401') ORDER BY 1
Which larger auto insurers had the worst complaint ratios in New York in 2024?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings

SELECT company_name, try_cast(ratio AS double) AS complaint_ratio FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2024' AND try_cast(premiums_written_in_millions AS double) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many patent assignments were recorded in each recent year?
SELECT substr(record_dt, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignment WHERE length(record_dt) = 9 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the most citizens of voting age?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rural health clinic cost reports cover fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_rhc17_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which reactors were shut down for the longest stretch in 2022?
SELECT trim(unit) AS unit, count(*) AS days_at_zero FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2022 %' AND try_cast(power AS double) = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many votes were cast for president in Wisconsin in 2016?
SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'WISCONSIN' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which metropolitan areas had the highest jobless rates on average in 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS metro_area, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'B' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'U' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M13' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Georgia's 2020 presidential vote was cast by mail?

SELECT mode, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'GEORGIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In which counties do subsidized households have the lowest average income?

SELECT name, states, try_cast(hh_income AS double) AS household_income FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' AND try_cast(hh_income AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(total_units AS double) >= 500 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. patents are design patents rather than utility patents?
SELECT patent_type, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which particles in the Particle Data Group listings carry a charge of plus two?
SELECT name, charge FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle WHERE try_cast(charge AS double) = 2 LIMIT 10
What do public housing tenants pay in rent each month on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rent_per_month AS double))) AS avg_rent FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE program_label = 'Public Housing' AND try_cast(rent_per_month AS double) > 0
What did vehicles hit first in the most fatal crashes of 2022?
SELECT harm_evname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people in the Bronx live below the poverty line?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36005' AND variable = 'B17001_E002'
On what grounds do federal civil cases most often claim jurisdiction?
SELECT jurisdiction_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE jurisdiction_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judges were confirmed by the Senate in 2014?
SELECT count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2014'
Which tax-exempt organisations report the largest revenue?
SELECT name, state, try_cast(revenue_amt AS double) AS revenue FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pages does a government form run on average?
SELECT avg(pages) AS average FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE pages > 0
Which countries publish the journals with the most PubMed articles?
SELECT journal_country, count(*) AS articles FROM govblock_health.pubmed_articles GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did Medicare pay on average for a hip or knee replacement without complications in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_payment FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_cd = '470'
Which states had the highest average residential electricity price in 2020?

SELECT column06 AS state, round(100 * sum(try_cast(revenues AS double)) / sum(try_cast(sales AS double)), 2) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many full-time-equivalent teachers worked in U.S. public schools in 2024-25?
SELECT round(sum(try_cast(teachers AS double))) AS teachers FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_059 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total'
Where in a patent are compounds found most often: description, claims, abstract, title or images?

SELECT f.field_name, count(*) AS mentions FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patent_compound_map AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_fields AS f ON cast(f.id AS varchar) = cast(m.field_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was ERCOT's peak hourly electricity demand in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.ERCO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '2023%'
Which congressional districts are the most compact in land area?
SELECT usps || '-' || substr(geoid, 3, 2) AS district, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_120cds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
What is the highest system-wide hourly load in ERCOT's weather-zone forecasts?
Ercot Load Forecast By Weather Zone Cdr Lfcweathernp
SELECT max(try_cast(systemtotal AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.ercot_load_forecast_by_weather_zone_cdr_lfcweathernp
Which states added the most wind capacity in 2021?
SELECT t_state, sum(try_cast(t_cap AS double)) / 1000 AS megawatts FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many reverse mortgages were made in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS reverse_mortgages FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(reverse_mortgage AS varchar) = '1'
Which states have the largest legislatures?
SELECT upper(substr(state_file, 1, 2)) AS state, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much more does a 64-year-old pay than a 21-year-old for marketplace coverage in Georgia? (2021)

SELECT age, avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)) AS avg_monthly_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE statecode = 'GA' AND cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021' AND age IN ('21', '64') AND tobacco <> 'Tobacco User' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which cities are served by the most separate water systems?

SELECT concat(city_served, ', ', state_served), count(DISTINCT pwsid) AS systems FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_geographic_areas WHERE city_served IS NOT NULL AND concat(city_served, ', ', state_served) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Texas or Florida add more people in 2025?
SELECT stname, try_cast(npopchg2025 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' AND stname IN ('Texas', 'Florida') ORDER BY 2 DESC
Which agencies have sent the most rules to the White House regulatory office for review?

SELECT a.name AS agency, count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed e JOIN govblock_executive.oira_agy_agency_list a ON a.agency_code = e.agency_code GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many preprints are in the ChemRxiv collection?
SELECT count(*) AS preprints FROM govblock_scholarly.chemrxiv_items
